name: Affinity Internet
summary: Melbourne ISP group (Affinity ISP Group: Bigfoot and Affinity Internet brands, 12,000 accounts); acquired by Datafast Telecommunications in Oct/Nov 2004 (renamed Eftel Dec 2005).

events.details: Melbourne-based Affinity ISP Group operating Bigfoot and Affinity Internet brands (12,000 active accounts at sale); founding year unknown.
Acquired by Datafast Telecommunications (announced 9 Nov 2004); took Datafast network to ~120,000 accounts.
